verdict.rationale: The evidence shows an Atlas Dashboard for payments activation and SAFEs, a Delaware registered agent, and community mentions of filing reminders and an onboarding checklist. None of it documents a dashboard listing every entity and state registration with good-standing status and upcoming deadlines. Community reports also say state-level registration work is left to the founder ("only solves half the problem"), so the reminders are an adjacent feature, not this capability.

support.subject: As a legal-ops lead, one dashboard shows every entity and state registration with its standing and upcoming deadlines
